verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a remote-desktop management product, but the evidence never documents acting on many devices or items in one operation. Server Pro's device groups, centralized settings, and management API are adjacent controls or developer building blocks, not a documented bulk-action capability. Unlimited concurrent sessions in tabs is parallel manual use, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
